verdict.rationale: Zapier documents a developer platform for building integrations: you design triggers and actions, wire up authentication and publish them. Builders can choose between a no-code Visual Builder and a Node.js-based Platform CLI that supports OAuth1/OAuth2, webhooks, polling triggers and HTTP middleware, and the probe confirms the CLI docs are live. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of private/unpublished (non-App-Directory) integrations, independent or hands-on corroboration of the connector-building experience.
